name: Barbarians get the Axe Throw cooldown fixer that removes Throw Weapon's weapon-speed cooldown (#9390)
contract: Throw Weapon (806877 and its ranks) has no recovery time in Spell.dbc, but the client shows the hasted ranged
weapon speed as its cooldown. The hidden passive "Axe Throw CD Fixer" 561174 is a -101% SPELLMOD_COOLDOWN
modifier on family 18 mask[1] 262144, which covers every Throw Weapon rank and Javelin Toss. A Barbarian knows
it, the modifier removes Throw Weapon's cooldown, and an existing Barbarian without it gets it back on login.

steps.label: A Barbarian knows the Axe Throw cooldown fixer
DISCRIMINATING: Throw Weapon's cooldown is modified to nothing
An older Barbarian without the fixer
The fixer comes back on login
